newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stock index hits all-time closing high.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stock index hits all-time closing high.

text.p: Toronto's key 300 index hit an all-time high on Monday as the rally in Canada's biggest stock market continues to roll along.
A strong currency, low interest rates and improving economy continue to lure investors to Canadian equities, analysts said.
The TSE 300 Composite Index jumped 25.81 points to finish at 5441.50, beating the previous record set on Friday.
"I think everybody is starting to get into the excitement of attaining these records," said Ira Katzin, an investment adviser with Richardson Greenshields of Canada Ltd.
The TSE posted gains in 10 of 14 sub-groups, led by conglomerates, banking and communications. Energy shares also got a lift from higher oil prices.
Despite the record close, Toronto's declining stocks edged past advances 466 to 456 with 294 issues unchanged. The heaviest losses were in consumer products and base metals.
"The Canadian dollar remains quite strong and Canada is finally getting its fiscal act together. Put that together with easing interest rates and you have exciting prospects," Katzin said.
* TimberWest Forest Ltd. jumped 2.80 to 19.80 on 1.5 million shares after the lumber firm said it will seek a buyer.
* Among rate sensitive stocks, Bank of Montreal closed up 0.50 at 38.55 after earlier hitting a 52-week peak of 38.65.
Toronto-Dominion Bank climbed 0.45 to close at 29.95, but earlier reached a 52-week high of 30.10.
* Takeover target Loewen Group Ltd. sank 1 to 54.10 amid market expectations that its battle with hostile bidder Service Corp. International will drag on for several months.
* SR Telecom Inc. climbed 1.65 to 9.25 after winning an C$86 million ($63 million) phone equipment order from Thailand.
